, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the Wilder House as Calvin Coolidge’s birthplace, conflating the Vermont State Historic Site’s Wilder House (his mother’s childhood home/tavern) with the actual birthplace house. This factual mix-up could lead to an incorrect location detail even though the town (Plymouth, Vermont) was correctly identified.
